title: boltons: Bug report (issue #455) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is boltons (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #455) from a user of this library:

> `boltons.urlutils.parse_qsl(qs, encoding='latin-1')` ignores the encoding: `parse_qsl('k=%E9', encoding='latin-1')` should give `[('k', 'é')]`, but the value is decoded as UTF-8. Keys have the same problem. The default behaviour (UTF-8) shouldn't change.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
